## 核心方向
**Redundancy-Stability Tradeoff**: GRPO alignment fundamentally fails on structurally pruned reasoning models — reward improves but accuracy never follows (universal decoupling). Pruning adds training collapse whose severity diagnoses structural damage type. Functional redundancy plays opposite roles under SFT vs RLVR recovery.

## 目标会议
EMNLP 2026 ARR May 25 提交（距今 ~9 天）
